description: Instrument recognition + genre classification of audio (a stem, a loop, a whole mix): instrument (e.g. "sub_bass", "drum_machine", "synth_lead", "string_section"), family, render (the doseedo_render_midi fields that play it), write (how its part is written), candidates[], resembles[] (what it sounds like without being it: a synth lead that resembles a brass section), confidence, notes {low, high, most} (its register), genre[] (top 3), character {tone bright|dark, drive clean|driven, length short|sustained, weight}, reads (playful | neutral | sleek: does it sound like a toy advert or a cartoon?) + playful 0–1, tags[] (AudioSet) and measured {rms_dbfs, centroid_hz, low_share, onsets_per_s}. USE THIS on a reference track and on each of its stems (doseedo_separate_stems returns stem_identity already) before writing: you cannot hear, and tempo and key say nothing about the SOUND. Run it on your own mix too and compare genre and character with the reference. A whole mix: read genre and character (instrument names only its loudest element). A silent stem answers silent:true — nothing to copy there. Pass audio_key (an upload) or audio_url (a result URL from another job as returned, or any public https URL). Up to 10 minutes of audio is analyzed. Synchronous (~1–5 s), no credits. Cancel: not applicable — the result is returned in the submit response; the job is already finished.

audio_key.description: R2 ingest key of an uploaded audio file (from doseedo_get_upload_url / POST /api/upload/r2/ingest-url; starts with "ingest/"). Provide this or audio_url.

audio_url.description: https URL of the audio (a doseedo result URL as returned — a stem, a take — or any public URL). Alternative to audio_key.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Any unique string for THIS request (e.g. a UUID). Re-sending the same call with the same key after a timeout returns the same job instead of starting a second one.

want.description: Which answers to compute (default all three).

name: doseedo_identify_sound
title: Identify a sound
